spec.description: Hosts, virtual machines, virtual hard disks and storage of a Hyper-V failover cluster.
Memory assigned to all VMs as a share of the host's physical memory. Needs the memory collector.
spec.title: VM memory / host RAM

spec.description: Virtual disks with an average latency per I/O above 0.01 s and at least one I/O per second.
spec.title: Slow virtual disks

spec.expr: 1 - max by (vm) (windows_hyperv_dynamic_memory_vm_guest_available_bytes{job=~"$job", instance="$instance"}) / max by (vm) (windows_hyperv_dynamic_memory_vm_guest_visible_physical_memory_bytes{job=~"$job", instance="$instance"})

sum by (vm) (rate(windows_hyperv_hypervisor_virtual_processor_run_time_seconds_total{job=~"$job", instance="$instance"}[$__rate_interval])) / max by (vm) (windows_hyperv_vm_processors{job=~"$job", instance="$instance"})

sum by (vm) ((rate(windows_hyperv_virtual_storage_device_operations_read_total{job=~"$job", instance="$instance"}[$__rate_interval]) + rate(windows_hyperv_virtual_storage_device_operations_written_total{job=~"$job", instance="$instance"}[$__rate_interval])) * on (instance, device) group_left (vm, path) (0 * topk by (instance, device) (1, max by (instance, device, vm, path) (windows_hyperv_virtual_hard_disk_size_bytes{job=~"$job", instance="$instance", device!=""})) + 1))

sum by (vm) (rate(windows_hyperv_virtual_storage_device_io_latency_seconds_total{job=~"$job", instance="$instance"}[$__rate_interval]) * on (instance, device) group_left (vm, path) (0 * topk by (instance, device) (1, max by (instance, device, vm, path) (windows_hyperv_virtual_hard_disk_size_bytes{job=~"$job", instance="$instance", device!=""})) + 1)) / (sum by (vm) (rate(windows_hyperv_virtual_storage_device_throughput_total{job=~"$job", instance="$instance"}[$__rate_interval]) * on (instance, device) group_left (vm, path) (0 * topk by (instance, device) (1, max by (instance, device, vm, path) (windows_hyperv_virtual_hard_disk_size_bytes{job=~"$job", instance="$instance", device!=""})) + 1)) > 0)

spec.description: VMs running on this host. CPU usage is busy time on the host's physical processors relative to the VM's own virtual processors, not the utilization Task Manager shows inside the VM; committed vs. RAM is the Hyper-V memory demand (guest commit charge) as a share of the assigned memory.
spec.title: Virtual machines

spec.expr: topk(10, sum by (vm) (rate(windows_hyperv_hypervisor_virtual_processor_run_time_seconds_total{job=~"$job", instance="$instance"}[$__rate_interval])) / max by (vm) (windows_hyperv_vm_processors{job=~"$job", instance="$instance"}))

spec.description: The ten VMs with the highest CPU usage at each point in time, so the graph can show more than ten VMs over the time range relative to their own virtual processors (run time per second; 100% means every virtual processor ran all the time). Near 100% a VM runs at its limit and needs more virtual processors, even when the host has CPU left. This is busy time on the host's physical processors as Hyper-V sees it, not the utilization Task Manager shows inside the VM: when a virtual processor waits for a physical processor, the guest counts that time as busy, the host doesn't.
spec.title: Busiest VMs

spec.expr: max by (device, disk, vm) (label_replace(topk(10, count_over_time((rate(windows_hyperv_virtual_storage_device_io_latency_seconds_total{job=~"$job", instance="$instance"}[$__rate_interval]) / (rate(windows_hyperv_virtual_storage_device_throughput_total{job=~"$job", instance="$instance"}[$__rate_interval]) > 1) > 0.01)[$__range:5m]) * 300) * on (instance, device) group_left (vm, path) (0 * topk by (instance, device) (1, max by (instance, device, vm, path) (windows_hyperv_virtual_hard_disk_size_bytes{job=~"$job", instance="$instance", device!=""})) + 1), "disk", "$1", "path", ".*[\\\\/]([^\\\\/]+)$"))

max by (device, disk, vm) (label_replace(avg_over_time((rate(windows_hyperv_virtual_storage_device_io_latency_seconds_total{job=~"$job", instance="$instance"}[$__rate_interval]) / (rate(windows_hyperv_virtual_storage_device_throughput_total{job=~"$job", instance="$instance"}[$__rate_interval]) > 1))[$__range:5m]) and on (instance, device) topk(10, count_over_time((rate(windows_hyperv_virtual_storage_device_io_latency_seconds_total{job=~"$job", instance="$instance"}[$__rate_interval]) / (rate(windows_hyperv_virtual_storage_device_throughput_total{job=~"$job", instance="$instance"}[$__rate_interval]) > 1) > 0.01)[$__range:5m]) * 300) * on (instance, device) group_left (vm, path) (0 * topk by (instance, device) (1, max by (instance, device, vm, path) (windows_hyperv_virtual_hard_disk_size_bytes{job=~"$job", instance="$instance", device!=""})) + 1), "disk", "$1", "path", ".*[\\\\/]([^\\\\/]+)$"))

max by (device, disk, vm) (label_replace(max_over_time((rate(windows_hyperv_virtual_storage_device_io_latency_seconds_total{job=~"$job", instance="$instance"}[$__rate_interval]) / (rate(windows_hyperv_virtual_storage_device_throughput_total{job=~"$job", instance="$instance"}[$__rate_interval]) > 1))[$__range:5m]) and on (instance, device) topk(10, count_over_time((rate(windows_hyperv_virtual_storage_device_io_latency_seconds_total{job=~"$job", instance="$instance"}[$__rate_interval]) / (rate(windows_hyperv_virtual_storage_device_throughput_total{job=~"$job", instance="$instance"}[$__rate_interval]) > 1) > 0.01)[$__range:5m]) * 300) * on (instance, device) group_left (vm, path) (0 * topk by (instance, device) (1, max by (instance, device, vm, path) (windows_hyperv_virtual_hard_disk_size_bytes{job=~"$job", instance="$instance", device!=""})) + 1), "disk", "$1", "path", ".*[\\\\/]([^\\\\/]+)$"))

max by (device, disk, vm) (label_replace(avg_over_time((rate(windows_hyperv_virtual_storage_device_operations_read_total{job=~"$job", instance="$instance"}[$__rate_interval]) + rate(windows_hyperv_virtual_storage_device_operations_written_total{job=~"$job", instance="$instance"}[$__rate_interval]))[$__range:5m]) and on (instance, device) topk(10, count_over_time((rate(windows_hyperv_virtual_storage_device_io_latency_seconds_total{job=~"$job", instance="$instance"}[$__rate_interval]) / (rate(windows_hyperv_virtual_storage_device_throughput_total{job=~"$job", instance="$instance"}[$__rate_interval]) > 1) > 0.01)[$__range:5m]) * 300) * on (instance, device) group_left (vm, path) (0 * topk by (instance, device) (1, max by (instance, device, vm, path) (windows_hyperv_virtual_hard_disk_size_bytes{job=~"$job", instance="$instance", device!=""})) + 1), "disk", "$1", "path", ".*[\\\\/]([^\\\\/]+)$"))

spec.description: Virtual disks that were above 0.01 s average latency per I/O in the time range, worst first. Time above threshold is counted in 5-minute steps, so permanently slow disks rank above short spikes. Disks with less than one I/O per second are ignored.
spec.title: Slowest virtual disks

spec.description: Maximum size of all virtual hard disks of the VMs on this host.
spec.title: VHD size

spec.description: Space the virtual hard disk files of the VMs on this host take on storage. For a VM with checkpoints, only the current .avhdx counts, not its parent disks.
spec.title: VHD file size

spec.expr: sum(clamp_min(max by (instance, path) (windows_hyperv_virtual_hard_disk_size_bytes{job=~"$job", instance="$instance", type="dynamic"}) - max by (instance, path) (windows_hyperv_virtual_hard_disk_file_size_bytes{job=~"$job", instance="$instance", type="dynamic"}), 0))

spec.description: Space the dynamic (thin provisioned) disks of the VMs on this host would still take if every one grew to its full size.
spec.title: VHD growth if thick

spec.expr: sum by (vm) (label_replace(rate(windows_hyperv_virtual_network_adapter_outgoing_dropped_packets_total{job=~"$job", instance="$instance"}[$__rate_interval]), "vm_id", "$1", "adapter", ".*_([0-9A-Fa-f]{8}-[0-9A-Fa-f]{4}-[0-9A-Fa-f]{4}-[0-9A-Fa-f]{4}-[0-9A-Fa-f]{12})--.*") * on (instance, vm_id) group_left (vm) (0 * max by (instance, vm_id, vm) (windows_hyperv_vm_processors{job=~"$job", instance="$instance"}) + 1))

sum by (vm) (label_replace(rate(windows_hyperv_virtual_network_adapter_incoming_dropped_packets_total{job=~"$job", instance="$instance"}[$__rate_interval]), "vm_id", "$1", "adapter", ".*_([0-9A-Fa-f]{8}-[0-9A-Fa-f]{4}-[0-9A-Fa-f]{4}-[0-9A-Fa-f]{4}-[0-9A-Fa-f]{12})--.*") * on (instance, vm_id) group_left (vm) (0 * max by (instance, vm_id, vm) (windows_hyperv_vm_processors{job=~"$job", instance="$instance"}) + 1))

spec.description: Packets dropped per second by the network adapters of each VM; incoming drops are drawn below the axis. Adapters are matched to VMs by the VM GUID in their name.
spec.title: Dropped packets per VM

spec.description: Host that runs the VM now. During a live migration, both hosts are shown.
spec.title: Host

spec.description: Virtual processors assigned to the VM.
spec.title: Virtual processors

spec.description: Physical memory the host currently assigns to the VM, for static and dynamic memory.
spec.title: Assigned memory

spec.description: Memory the guest uses: visible memory minus the memory the guest reports as available. Empty when the guest doesn't report available memory (no integration services).
spec.title: RAM in use

spec.description: Hyper-V memory demand as a share of the assigned memory. The demand follows the guest's commit charge, not the RAM in use. Above 100% the guest has committed more memory than it has RAM: the rest is only reserved or paged out. Check paging inside the guest before adding RAM. Applies to static and dynamic memory.
spec.title: Committed vs. RAM

spec.description: Run time per second of all virtual processors, as a share of the VM's virtual processors: 100% means every virtual processor ran all the time. Near 100% the VM runs at its own limit. This is busy time on the host's physical processors as Hyper-V sees it, not the utilization Task Manager shows inside the VM: when a virtual processor waits for a physical processor, the guest counts that time as busy, the host doesn't.
spec.title: CPU usage

spec.expr: sum by (state) (rate(windows_hyperv_hypervisor_virtual_processor_mode_time_seconds_total{job=~"$job", instance=~"$cluster_instance", vm="$vm"}[$__rate_interval])) / scalar(max(windows_hyperv_vm_processors{job=~"$job", instance=~"$cluster_instance", vm="$vm"}))

spec.description: Run time per second of the VM's virtual processors, split into running guest code, the hypervisor working for the VM, and remote (on another NUMA node); 100% means every virtual processor ran all the time. This is busy time on the host's physical processors as Hyper-V sees it, not the utilization Task Manager shows inside the VM: when a virtual processor waits for a physical processor, the guest counts that time as busy, the host doesn't.
spec.title: CPU usage by state

spec.description: Share of time each virtual processor spent running: run time per second, so 100% means it ran all the time. One busy virtual processor while the others idle points to a single-threaded workload. This is busy time on the host's physical processors as Hyper-V sees it, not the utilization Task Manager shows inside the VM: when a virtual processor waits for a physical processor, the guest counts that time as busy, the host doesn't.
spec.title: CPU usage per virtual processor

spec.description: In use: memory the guest occupies. Assigned: physical memory from the host. Visible: memory the guest sees (with dynamic memory up to its maximum).
spec.title: RAM in use and assigned

spec.description: Hyper-V memory demand (commit charge of the guest) as a share of the assigned memory. Above 100% the guest has committed more than its RAM; that is only a problem when it pages a lot. With dynamic memory, Hyper-V adds memory to keep this near its buffer.
spec.title: Committed vs. RAM

spec.description: Memory Hyper-V added to (up) and removed from (down) the VM. Always zero for static memory.
spec.title: Dynamic memory changes

spec.description: Maximum size of all virtual hard disks of the VM, as the guest sees them. For a VM with checkpoints, the current checkpoint disk counts.
spec.title: Disk size

spec.description: Space the virtual hard disk files take on storage. Thin provisioned (dynamic) disks grow up to their size.
spec.title: Disk file size

spec.expr: sum(clamp_min(max by (path) (windows_hyperv_virtual_hard_disk_size_bytes{job=~"$job", instance=~"$cluster_instance", vm="$vm", type="dynamic"}) - max by (path) (windows_hyperv_virtual_hard_disk_file_size_bytes{job=~"$job", instance=~"$cluster_instance", vm="$vm"}), 0))

spec.description: Space the dynamic (thin provisioned) disks would still take if every one grew to its full size.
spec.title: Growth if thick

spec.expr: sum(max by (path) (windows_hyperv_virtual_hard_disk_file_size_bytes{job=~"$job", instance=~"$cluster_instance", vm="$vm"})) / sum(max by (path) (windows_hyperv_virtual_hard_disk_size_bytes{job=~"$job", instance=~"$cluster_instance", vm="$vm"}))

spec.description: File size of all disks as a share of their size.
spec.title: Disk fill

spec.expr: max by (path) (windows_hyperv_virtual_hard_disk_file_size_bytes{job=~"$job", instance=~"$cluster_instance", vm="$vm"}) / max by (path) (windows_hyperv_virtual_hard_disk_size_bytes{job=~"$job", instance=~"$cluster_instance", vm="$vm"})

clamp_min(max by (path) (windows_hyperv_virtual_hard_disk_size_bytes{job=~"$job", instance=~"$cluster_instance", vm="$vm", type="dynamic"}) - max by (path) (windows_hyperv_virtual_hard_disk_file_size_bytes{job=~"$job", instance=~"$cluster_instance", vm="$vm"}), 0)

spec.description: Every virtual hard disk of the VM. Type is fixed (thick), dynamic (thin), differencing (checkpoint or child disk) or unknown. For a checkpoint, the file size only counts the current .avhdx, not its parent disks.
spec.title: Virtual hard disks

spec.expr: label_replace(sum by (path) (rate(windows_hyperv_virtual_storage_device_operations_written_total{job=~"$job", instance=~"$cluster_instance"}[$__rate_interval]) * on (instance, device) group_left (vm, path) (0 * topk by (instance, device) (1, max by (instance, device, vm, path) (windows_hyperv_virtual_hard_disk_size_bytes{job=~"$job", instance=~"$cluster_instance", vm="$vm", device!=""})) + 1)), "disk", "$1", "path", ".*[\\\\/]([^\\\\/]+)$")

label_replace(sum by (path) (rate(windows_hyperv_virtual_storage_device_operations_read_total{job=~"$job", instance=~"$cluster_instance"}[$__rate_interval]) * on (instance, device) group_left (vm, path) (0 * topk by (instance, device) (1, max by (instance, device, vm, path) (windows_hyperv_virtual_hard_disk_size_bytes{job=~"$job", instance=~"$cluster_instance", vm="$vm", device!=""})) + 1)), "disk", "$1", "path", ".*[\\\\/]([^\\\\/]+)$")

spec.description: Read and write operations per second of each disk; reads are drawn below the axis. Disks of a VM that isn't running have no I/O.
spec.title: Disk IOPS

spec.expr: label_replace(sum by (path) (rate(windows_hyperv_virtual_storage_device_written_bytes_total{job=~"$job", instance=~"$cluster_instance"}[$__rate_interval]) * on (instance, device) group_left (vm, path) (0 * topk by (instance, device) (1, max by (instance, device, vm, path) (windows_hyperv_virtual_hard_disk_size_bytes{job=~"$job", instance=~"$cluster_instance", vm="$vm", device!=""})) + 1)), "disk", "$1", "path", ".*[\\\\/]([^\\\\/]+)$")

label_replace(sum by (path) (rate(windows_hyperv_virtual_storage_device_read_bytes_total{job=~"$job", instance=~"$cluster_instance"}[$__rate_interval]) * on (instance, device) group_left (vm, path) (0 * topk by (instance, device) (1, max by (instance, device, vm, path) (windows_hyperv_virtual_hard_disk_size_bytes{job=~"$job", instance=~"$cluster_instance", vm="$vm", device!=""})) + 1)), "disk", "$1", "path", ".*[\\\\/]([^\\\\/]+)$")

spec.description: Bytes written and read per second of each disk; reads are drawn below the axis.
spec.title: Disk throughput

spec.expr: label_replace(sum by (path) (rate(windows_hyperv_virtual_storage_device_io_latency_seconds_total{job=~"$job", instance=~"$cluster_instance"}[$__rate_interval]) * on (instance, device) group_left (vm, path) (0 * topk by (instance, device) (1, max by (instance, device, vm, path) (windows_hyperv_virtual_hard_disk_size_bytes{job=~"$job", instance=~"$cluster_instance", vm="$vm", device!=""})) + 1)) / (sum by (path) (rate(windows_hyperv_virtual_storage_device_throughput_total{job=~"$job", instance=~"$cluster_instance"}[$__rate_interval]) * on (instance, device) group_left (vm, path) (0 * topk by (instance, device) (1, max by (instance, device, vm, path) (windows_hyperv_virtual_hard_disk_size_bytes{job=~"$job", instance=~"$cluster_instance", vm="$vm", device!=""})) + 1)) > 0), "disk", "$1", "path", ".*[\\\\/]([^\\\\/]+)$")

spec.description: Average latency per I/O of each disk: total I/O latency divided by completed I/O transfers. The dashed line is the slow-disk threshold.
spec.title: Disk latency

spec.expr: label_replace(sum by (adapter) (label_replace(rate(windows_hyperv_virtual_network_adapter_sent_bytes_total{job=~"$job", instance=~"$cluster_instance"}[$__rate_interval]), "vm_id", "$1", "adapter", ".*_([0-9A-Fa-f]{8}-[0-9A-Fa-f]{4}-[0-9A-Fa-f]{4}-[0-9A-Fa-f]{4}-[0-9A-Fa-f]{12})--.*") * on (instance, vm_id) group_left (vm) (0 * max by (instance, vm_id, vm) (windows_hyperv_vm_processors{job=~"$job", instance=~"$cluster_instance", vm="$vm"}) + 1)) * 8, "nic", "$1", "adapter", "[^_]*_(.*)_[0-9A-Fa-f]{8}-.*")

label_replace(sum by (adapter) (label_replace(rate(windows_hyperv_virtual_network_adapter_received_bytes_total{job=~"$job", instance=~"$cluster_instance"}[$__rate_interval]), "vm_id", "$1", "adapter", ".*_([0-9A-Fa-f]{8}-[0-9A-Fa-f]{4}-[0-9A-Fa-f]{4}-[0-9A-Fa-f]{4}-[0-9A-Fa-f]{12})--.*") * on (instance, vm_id) group_left (vm) (0 * max by (instance, vm_id, vm) (windows_hyperv_vm_processors{job=~"$job", instance=~"$cluster_instance", vm="$vm"}) + 1)) * 8, "nic", "$1", "adapter", "[^_]*_(.*)_[0-9A-Fa-f]{8}-.*")

spec.description: Traffic of each network adapter of the VM; received traffic is drawn below the axis. Adapters are matched by the VM GUID in their name.
spec.title: Network throughput

spec.expr: label_replace(sum by (adapter) (label_replace(rate(windows_hyperv_virtual_network_adapter_outgoing_dropped_packets_total{job=~"$job", instance=~"$cluster_instance"}[$__rate_interval]), "vm_id", "$1", "adapter", ".*_([0-9A-Fa-f]{8}-[0-9A-Fa-f]{4}-[0-9A-Fa-f]{4}-[0-9A-Fa-f]{4}-[0-9A-Fa-f]{12})--.*") * on (instance, vm_id) group_left (vm) (0 * max by (instance, vm_id, vm) (windows_hyperv_vm_processors{job=~"$job", instance=~"$cluster_instance", vm="$vm"}) + 1)), "nic", "$1", "adapter", "[^_]*_(.*)_[0-9A-Fa-f]{8}-.*")

label_replace(sum by (adapter) (label_replace(rate(windows_hyperv_virtual_network_adapter_incoming_dropped_packets_total{job=~"$job", instance=~"$cluster_instance"}[$__rate_interval]), "vm_id", "$1", "adapter", ".*_([0-9A-Fa-f]{8}-[0-9A-Fa-f]{4}-[0-9A-Fa-f]{4}-[0-9A-Fa-f]{4}-[0-9A-Fa-f]{12})--.*") * on (instance, vm_id) group_left (vm) (0 * max by (instance, vm_id, vm) (windows_hyperv_vm_processors{job=~"$job", instance=~"$cluster_instance", vm="$vm"}) + 1)), "nic", "$1", "adapter", "[^_]*_(.*)_[0-9A-Fa-f]{8}-.*")

spec.description: Packets dropped per second by each network adapter of the VM; incoming drops are drawn below the axis.
spec.title: Network dropped packets

spec.expr: count(max by (node) (windows_mscluster_node_state{job=~"$job", instance=~"$cluster_instance"}) == 0) or (0 * count(max by (node) (windows_mscluster_node_state{job=~"$job", instance=~"$cluster_instance"})))

spec.description: Cluster nodes in state Up. Requires the mscluster collector, which is not enabled by default.
spec.title: Nodes up

spec.expr: count(max by (node) (windows_mscluster_node_state{job=~"$job", instance=~"$cluster_instance"}) != 0) or (0 * count(max by (node) (windows_mscluster_node_state{job=~"$job", instance=~"$cluster_instance"})))

spec.description: Cluster nodes that are down, paused or joining. A paused node runs no new roles, for example during maintenance.
spec.title: Nodes not up

spec.expr: count(max by (resource_group) (windows_mscluster_resourcegroup_state{job=~"$job", instance=~"$cluster_instance"}) >= 2 < 4) or (0 * count(max by (resource_group) (windows_mscluster_resourcegroup_state{job=~"$job", instance=~"$cluster_instance"})))

spec.description: Resource groups (cluster roles, for example VMs) that failed or are only partially online.
spec.title: Groups failed

spec.expr: count(max by (resource_group) (windows_mscluster_resourcegroup_state{job=~"$job", instance=~"$cluster_instance"}) == 1) or (0 * count(max by (resource_group) (windows_mscluster_resourcegroup_state{job=~"$job", instance=~"$cluster_instance"})))

spec.description: Resource groups that are offline, for example stopped VMs. Offline is often intended.
spec.title: Groups offline

spec.expr: count(max by (resource, type, resource_group) (windows_mscluster_resource_state{job=~"$job", instance=~"$cluster_instance"}) == 4) or (0 * count(max by (resource, type, resource_group) (windows_mscluster_resource_state{job=~"$job", instance=~"$cluster_instance"})))

spec.description: Cluster resources in state Failed.
spec.title: Resources failed

spec.expr: count(max by (network) (windows_mscluster_network_state{job=~"$job", instance=~"$cluster_instance"}) != 3) or (0 * count(max by (network) (windows_mscluster_network_state{job=~"$job", instance=~"$cluster_instance"})))

spec.description: Cluster networks that are unavailable, down or partitioned. A partitioned network has lost connectivity between some nodes.
spec.title: Networks not up

spec.description: Quorum type of the cluster: node majority, file share witness or disk (storage) witness.
spec.title: Quorum

spec.description: State, drain status, current vote, owned resource groups and build of each cluster node. Dynamic quorum removes the vote of some nodes to keep quorum when nodes fail.
spec.title: Nodes

spec.description: State of each cluster node over time.
spec.title: Node state

spec.description: Resource groups each node owns. Steps show failovers and live migrations; a node without groups runs no roles.
spec.title: Resource groups per node

spec.expr: max by (resource_group, node) (windows_mscluster_resourcegroup_owner_node{job=~"$job", instance=~"$cluster_instance"} == 1) and on (resource_group) (max by (resource_group) (windows_mscluster_resourcegroup_state{job=~"$job", instance=~"$cluster_instance"}) != 0)

spec.description: Resource groups that are not online and the node that owns them. Offline groups of stopped VMs are listed too.
spec.title: Resource groups not online

spec.expr: max by (resource, node) (windows_mscluster_resource_owner_node{job=~"$job", instance=~"$cluster_instance"} == 1) and on (resource) (max by (resource, type, resource_group) (windows_mscluster_resource_state{job=~"$job", instance=~"$cluster_instance"}) != 2)

spec.description: Cluster resources that are not online, with their type, resource group and owner node.
spec.title: Resources not online

spec.description: State, role and metric of each cluster network. The cluster prefers networks with a lower metric for cluster traffic.
spec.title: Networks

spec.expr: count(max by (node) (windows_mscluster_node_state{job=~"$job", instance=~"$cluster_instance"}) == 0) or (0 * count(max by (node) (windows_mscluster_node_state{job=~"$job", instance=~"$cluster_instance"})))

spec.description: Cluster nodes in state Up, of all nodes. Requires the mscluster collector.
spec.title: Nodes up

spec.description: Virtual machines running on the hosts of the cluster. Needs the hyperv collector, which is not enabled by default.
spec.title: Running VMs

spec.description: Virtual machines reporting critical health on any host of the cluster.
spec.title: VMs in critical health

spec.description: Virtual processors assigned to VMs per logical processor, over all hosts of the cluster.
spec.title: vCPU per logical CPU

spec.expr: sum(sum by (instance) (windows_hyperv_dynamic_memory_vm_physical_bytes{job=~"$job", instance=~"$cluster_instance"})) / sum(max by (instance) (windows_memory_physical_total_bytes{job=~"$job", instance=~"$cluster_instance"}))

spec.description: Memory assigned to all VMs as a share of the physical memory of all hosts. Needs the memory collector.
spec.title: VM memory / host RAM

spec.expr: sum(sum by (instance) (windows_hyperv_dynamic_memory_vm_physical_bytes{job=~"$job", instance=~"$cluster_instance"})) / (sum(max by (instance) (windows_memory_physical_total_bytes{job=~"$job", instance=~"$cluster_instance"})) - max(max by (instance) (windows_memory_physical_total_bytes{job=~"$job", instance=~"$cluster_instance"})))

spec.description: Memory assigned to all VMs as a share of the physical memory left when the host with the most memory fails. Above 100%, not all VMs can restart after a host failure.
spec.title: VM memory without largest host

spec.description: Share of all logical processors of the cluster running guest code or the hypervisor.
spec.title: Host CPU usage

spec.description: Virtual disks of the cluster with an average latency per I/O above 0.01 s and at least one I/O per second.
spec.title: Slow virtual disks

spec.expr: max by (instance) (windows_hyperv_assigned_vm_processors{job=~"$job", instance=~"$cluster_instance"}) / max by (instance) (windows_hyperv_host_logical_processors{job=~"$job", instance=~"$cluster_instance"})
